confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors draw on several Marrakech-specific aggregated price sources with mixed dates. Accommodation and drink anchors are lower confidence: sources were crowd-sourced, inconsistent, or undated, and the July window was not checked against seasonal listings. Dollar figures for dirham prices were converted at approximate rates. The FX rate came from RBA exchange-rate content surfaced in search results; I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Marrakech-specific aggregated sources (cost-of-living guides, hostel and hotel listing averages, and drink price aggregators), adjusted for typical tourist-area and local-venue pricing.
